rationale: Asserts only GET /catalog-search -> 200, which CatalogSearchRestApiCest already covers three times over with stronger Accept-header assertions. Its remaining value is fail-fast gating of the E2E lane, not coverage.
recommended_action: drop unless the smoke lane's fail-fast gating is worth keeping the duplicate

rationale: POST <glue-backend>/token -> 200 has no Codeception equivalent; the Glue index has /access-tokens, /agent-access-tokens, /company-user-access-tokens and /refresh-tokens but no backend token endpoint. Backend-auth Cests obtain the token through a helper and never assert the endpoint itself.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cms/cms-page-search-dms.cy.ts::should be able to see the cms page for new store
rationale: Only the final assertion is API-level (GET /cms-pages with a Store header). The setup is a back-office UI journey: create a store, create a CMS page, trigger publish and sync. Moving it to Codeception requires both to be seedable as fixtures.
recommended_action: keep in Cypress until store + CMS page can be seeded as dynamic fixtures, then migrate

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cart/cart-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should add a configurable product to the cart
rationale: Same claim: POST a configurable item, the cart item carries the submitted configuration.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cart/cart-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should update configuration and quantity of a configurable product in the cart
rationale: The cart PATCH ignores a submitted configuration, so the real claim is that configuration and price survive a quantity update; the target asserts exactly that.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cart/cart-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should delete a configurable product item from the cart
rationale: No configuration-specific branch on the DELETE path; the generic cart-item delete test covers it.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cart/cart-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should not add a configurable product to the cart with ${description}
rationale: Collapses five cases. Prices NotBlank/GreaterThanOrEqual are in the target; quantity NotBlank and GreaterThan are testGivenABlankSkuAndNoQuantityWhenPostCartItemThenBothAreRejected and testGivenAQuantityAtItsLowerBoundWhenPostCartItemThenItIsRejected.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cart/cart-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should not add a configurable product to the cart with missing isComplete
cypress:cypress/e2e/api/checkout/checkout-configurable-product.cy.ts::should create an order with a configurable product
rationale: Same journey, plus the configuration is asserted on the order. The incomplete-configuration refusal is covered too, which Cypress never tested.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/shopping-list/shopping-list-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should add a configurable product to the shopping list
rationale: The target posts a configurable product and asserts the configuration instance on the response and the follow-up collection.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/shopping-list/shopping-list-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should update the quantity of a configurable product in the shopping list
rationale: Same claim on a configured item, with the configuration instance asserted after the PATCH.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/shopping-list/shopping-list-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should update the configuration of a configurable product in the shopping list
rationale: No Glue test PATCHes a changed configuration: testGivenAPersistedItemWhenPatchQuantityThenItIsUpdated resends the same one and only asserts the configuration is present.
recommended_action: add a PATCH test that changes displayData and asserts the new value before this spec is deleted

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/shopping-list/shopping-list-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should remove a configurable product from the shopping list
rationale: No configuration-specific branch on the DELETE path; the target deletes a configured item.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/shopping-list/shopping-list-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should add two configurable products with different configurations to the shopping list
rationale: Shopping lists never merge by SKU, so two adds always make two rows whatever the configuration says. The identity claim is cart-side and tested in ProductConfigurationCartItemsStorefrontApiIntegrationTest::testGivenAConfigurableCartItemWhenPostTheSameProductWithAnotherConfigurationThenBothAreSeparateItems.

id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/shopping-list/shopping-list-items-configurable-product.cy.ts::should not add a configurable product to the shopping list with ${description}
rationale: Collapses fourteen cases. Prices are in the target; quantity, availableQuantity and isComplete are the sibling POST tests in the same class (BothRequiredFieldsBlank, QuantityThatIsNotAnInteger, QuantityAtItsLowerBound, NullAvailableQuantity, NonNumericAvailableQuantity, AnAbsentIsComplete, NonBooleanIsComplete).
